candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis dependency is timing out: inventory logs show 9 redis_operation_timeout errors with status 504, and topology confirms inventory depends on redis. This is the only error-level signal in the window.
candidates.uncertainty: Order checkout trace is OK and gateway/order/payment logs are healthy, so end-to-end impact of the inventory Redis timeouts is not yet demonstrated.

report.explanation: Inventory logs show repeated redis_operation_timeout errors (504) and topology confirms inventory->redis, supporting a bounded redis-timeout candidate. Gateway, order, and payment telemetry are healthy and the order deployment is old and valid, so no other cause is established. Redis-side evidence is still needed to confirm origin and impact.
